`F4Graph3840Certificates.log`, `F4Graph3840Diameter.log`, `F4Graph3840Exact.log`).

### Translation & Alignment
- **Definitions**: [`F4Graph3840.graph`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840.lean#L52-L56) is an undirected loopless graph on $|V| = 3840$ with max degree $\le 20$. [`DiameterAtMost graph 3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/SingleExtension.lean#L15-L16) faithfully uses Mathlib’s native `SimpleGraph.Walk`: $\forall u\ v, \exists p : G.\text{Walk } u\ v, p.\text{length} \le 3$.
- **Discharge Trace**: Any pair $(u, v)$ splits on whether controllers are adjacent:
  1. *Adjacent*: Discharged by 3-step folded paths via [`adjacent_valid`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Certificates.lean#L191) and [`adjacent_center`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840DecoderInterface.lean#L19-L24).
  2. *Equal/Non-adjacent*: Discharged by 3-step words ([`controller_valid`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Certificates.lean#L65)) and $\mathbb{F}_4$-affine basis noise decoding ([`noise_decode_of_basis`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840DecoderInterface.lean#L4-L12), [`nb_noise_valid`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Certificates.lean#L254-L256)).
- **Diameter Exact 3**: Lower bound $\neg \text{DiameterAtMost } 2$ is certified on $(0, 6)$ via [`exists_eq_cons_of_ne`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Lower.lean#L16) and 1/2-step path exclusion.
- **Axioms**: Final theorems [`concrete_order_degree_and_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Exact.lean#L8-L11) and [`diameter_exact_three_in_project_definition`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F4Graph3840Exact.lean#L13-L15) carry no remaining unproved hypotheses and depend strictly on standard Lean foundations `[Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]` (no `sorryAx`, no `native_decide`).

### Gaps
None. No semantic or caller gaps identified in the declaration bodies or caller chain.

### Verdict & Limits
**PASS** (Checkpoint C).
*Limits:* Based on direct reading and audit of final source files and kernel receipt logs (distinguished from running an active local build). Mathematical verification certifies the $(20, 3)$ instance; it does not constitute a certified global world-record claim.
